title: When comparison keeps stealing steadiness as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind keeps measuring worth and direction against other people. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Gurbani returns dignity to remembrance, contentment, and the work in front of you. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart.
actionPrompt: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Repeat what you can actually keep.
